name: Karrar main battle tank
armament: 125 mm 2A46-type smoothbore with autoloader, can fire gun-launched ATGM
12.7 mm MG in roof remote weapon station
protection: Composite turret armour plus Iranian ERA on glacis, turret and side skirts; slat armour at the rear; some carry laser-warning 'dazzler' boxes. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetration needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon, best against side, rear and engine deck.
visual_notes: T-72 lower hull: 6 large road wheels per side, rubber side skirts covered in ERA bricks
Welded angular turret in the style of the T-90MS with a thick, flat-faced front and a large rear bustle
125 mm gun with fume extractor and thermal sleeve (service tanks have no barrel sheet)
Remote weapon station on the turret roof, sighting heads and four dazzler boxes on some tanks
Slat cage over the engine deck rear; usually painted plain sand/tan
